description: Self-hosted Git forge: repositories, branches, files, issues, pull requests, reviews, releases, Actions, organizations, teams, users, packages and the admin API. Webhooks, mirrors, migrations, workflow dispatch, pull request merges, releases, invitations and user creation are held for approval.
